About me

I have an MSc in Cybersecurity from Dublin Business School and hands-on experience in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and detection engineering.

My main project is a Python platform that maps system behaviour to CVE/CVSS risk and MITRE ATT&CK techniques, explains every finding, and rebuilds the exploit sequence behind it. I also built a secure, automated deployment pipeline on AWS. I care about judging risk by how exploitable something really is in its environment, and about writing findings that engineers and non-technical reviewers can both use.

Selected work

Vulnerability detection and risk-scoring platform

A Python and Flask platform that takes system telemetry and produces findings with a risk rating, an ATT&CK technique, a clear explanation and the evidence trail behind them. Scroll through how a finding is made.

PythonFlaskMITRE ATT&CKCVE/CVSSSHAPD3.jsSysmonAWS

  1. Ingest telemetry

    Collects multi-source system telemetry, including Sysmon events.

  2. Map behaviour

    Maps component-level behaviour to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and CVE/CVSS-referenced risk.

  3. Judge exploitability

    Rates how exploitable each finding is in that specific system, not by base score alone. Tracks the processes, binaries, registry dependencies and versions involved, like a software bill of materials.

  4. Explain every decision

    Uses SHAP so each classification comes with a transparent, auditable reason.

  5. Rebuild the exploit chain

    A forensic module reconstructs exploit sequences from structured logs and packages the evidence for disclosure or investigation.

  6. Report

    A real-time D3.js dashboard shows KPI/KRI trends, risk scores and remediation status. Deployed on AWS.
